title: Hellenic Parliament
geometryBasis: Named native relation provides 36 outer controls with the portal projections and four inner court or lightwell polygons.
sectionBasis: The exact two Qualla originals supply the Syntagma facade, ochre wall tone, stone cornices, centered Doric portico and shallow pediment. The Parliament’s history describes the three-storey wings and additional porticos.
limitations: Building and parapet heights, local grades and roof details are estimated. The Syntagma side uses visible window counts and proportions from the exact originals. Equivalent rhythms and frames represent the sides and lightwells.
The model covers the Parliament building and attached entrances. The independently identified Tomb of the Unknown Soldier and plaza fountains are outside this structure.
